label: Simulation
tagline: Intuitive visualisation of real-world physical or temporal systems
description: Researches the right representation paradigm for a domain (2d-spatial-map / 3d-environment / iconographic-anim / hybrid) and orchestrates 7 component drawers + the 3 quality lenses to produce a lens-verified runnable simulation embedded as a canvas card. Runs 4-researcher fleet + synthesiser; user-steerage interrupt before any drawer fires; §8.3 loop-until-bar with 5-iteration cap; multi-draft at scene + loop cruxes via iterator-remix.

triggers.title: Bare Intent — chat
triggers.rule: When the user's message mentions a physical or temporal system to model (warehouse stock, garden, traffic, kitchen mid-service, power grid, aquarium, render farm, shift schedule, etc.) — FIRST action is a Task call to simulation-planner in BARE-INTENT MODE.

triggers.title: Stage I — bp_proto_build Phase 2b
triggers.rule: For each row in the PRD's Simulation table (PRD_VISUAL_RULES §5), bp_proto_build Phase 2b dispatches a per-simId bp_simulation_build agent which spawns simulation-planner.
